ns2:course.label: Computational Bioengineering
ns2:course.description: Mathematical and statistical models plus accompanying computational techniques central to many aspects of systems biology and bioengineering research. Theory of supervised and unsupervised learning; linear models; dimension reduction; Monte Carlo computation; analysis of gene expression data and genome sequence data; modeling of gene transcription network signaling pathways. Same as CSE 505. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: STAT 400.
